caption: Stadhuis, Almere
composition: Round council chamber between two five-storey wings on Stadhuisplein · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From Stadhuisplein the Almere city hall shows the round glass-and-steel council chamber over the entrance, set between two five-storey concrete and marble wings. The later curved glass wing stands on the far side and is not the front in this frame. The offices are closed. It is partly cloudy, about 14.4°C, with wind near 4.0 km/h and cloud cover about 67%. No wordmark is shown.
